topic: The woman hit by a meteorite
script: In 1954, a meteorite crashed through a roof in Alabama. It bounced off a radio and hit a woman named Ann Hodges as she napped. She was badly bruised but survived. She is the first person confirmed to have been hit by a meteorite. The rock was about the size of a grapefruit. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
